authorization: Human explicitly approved the next stage: 'So then go ahead and improve the equation for research4.' New bounded equation study; old consistency monitor remains stopped. Previous energy_response_v1 results/backups are immutable development evidence.
objective: Improve full finite activation-change-vector prediction at the same MLP, confirm prospectively on fresh question families/directions, and test a bounded endpoint-probability extension. No classifier, trained generator, site search or all-layer sweep.

model.checkpoint: Verified existing local BF16 stored weights, promoted by exact value for FP32 controls
model.attention_backend: SDPA MATH; native reference gated-delta kernels
model.normalization: Use actual epsilon and gain1+stored_norm_weight, including native forced-FP32 normalization/cast order

system: Give a concise answer in ordinary language.

questions.text: Why does a bicycle pump become warm while someone is pumping air?
Five envelopes contain four cards each. Three cards are removed from the collection. How many cards remain?
Explain what the Python expression [2, 5, 8][::-1] produces and how the slice works.
Describe a sensible sequence for sorting a drawer of mixed screws, washers and nails.
Explain why fewer coins is grammatical but less coins is usually avoided.
All copper tokens are round. No round token is wooden. Can a copper token be wooden? Explain.
Write a friendly two-sentence invitation to a neighborhood book swap.
Compare a library catalog with a book index, focusing on how each helps someone find information.

independence: Eight fresh exact prompts, four calibration and four held-out families. Earlier research exposed related broad domains; no novelty or population-generalization claim. Directions, positions, strengths and signs are repeated measurements, not additional independent questions.
positions: Prompt-end and first cached prediction after fixed tokenID760, real multi-token prefixes and fresh cloned native state. Exact tokenizer IDs must be compiled/hash-frozen before any model evaluation; reject prefixes longer than96 rather than truncate.

directions.construction: Four Gaussian draws projected off the prior study's four-direction span, then QR-orthonormalized in float64 with signs oriented toward original draws. All four are fresh. Directions0/1 are calibration,2/3 held-out. Save exact FP32/BF16 values and Gram/old-span leakage before model calls.

casting: FP32 x=fl32(h+fl32(alpha*v32)). BF16 cast v once, update=flBF16(alpha*vBF16), x=flBF16(hBF16+update). Record exact float64 x-h, requested alpha, projection/off-direction component and zero delivery/output. FP32 reference uses the identical BF16-derived incoming residual values promoted to FP32. Actual-input coefficients are computed before output measurements.

candidates.rational: s0/s(alpha)*[alpha*b1+alpha^2*(b2/2+(s1/s0)*b1)], s0=mean(h^2)+eps_norm,s1=2mean(h*v),s2=mean(v^2). Evaluate positive s(alpha) directly as mean((h+alpha*v)^2)+eps_norm in float64. Exact for the RMS-normalized quadratic-even subcomponent; approximate for full SwiGLU.
candidates.exact_norm_gate2: Use exact normalized displacement dz=N(h+alpha*v)-N(h), g0=Wg*N(h),u0=Wu*N(h),dg=Wg*dz,du=Wu*dz. Predict Wd{[f(g0)+f'(g0)dg+f''(g0)dg^2/2]*(u0+du)-f(g0)*u0}, f=SiLU. Only base-point gate derivatives are used; no perturbed sigmoid/output is consulted. No fitted parameter. Native BF16 rounding remains an unmodeled control effect.
candidates.full_residual: Add alpha*v to every nominal branch prediction. For actual-input controls add the actual delivered displacement. Do not scale the identity path by the normalization factor.

algebra_controls: Verify rational expansion matches Taylor through second order; verify the exact quadratic-even rational identity on calibration points in FP64; verify exact_norm_gate2 expansion through second order using known algebra/toy controls. Check actual-module analytic derivatives against autograd and FP64 finite differences on all calibration questions, both positions, directions0/1. Fixed tolerances: analytic/autograd1e-4, FP64 first1e-3, FP64 second1e-2, formula/native-FP32 relative1e-5. Positive denominator must be>=actual norm epsilon; no test-driven clamp or fitted stabilizer.
prediction_order: Save/hash all nominal and actual-input candidate predictions before corresponding perturbed output evaluation. Evaluate calibration questions/directions0/1 first, lock candidate selection using ONLY those FP32 responses, then measure remaining calibration-direction cross checks and held-out perturbations. Base activations at held-out points are allowed for context-specific derivatives; outputs are not used for fitting or selection.
selection_rule: Default candidate is rational. Select exact_norm_gate2 only if: on every calibration question its strong-band median full-vector relative error is no larger than rational for BOTH branch/full maps; its overall strong-band median branch error is<=0.8*rational; and all resolved small-band calibration errors<=5%. Strong band0.5/1.25/2; small band0.0078125/0.03125. No selection from held-out scores; report all four candidates regardless.
primary_support: On every held-out question, selected normalized equation's strong-band median full-vector relative error must be<=0.75*ordinary quadratic, for BOTH branch/full maps. At strength2 each question's median<=30% and every resolved case<=50%. Retain small-band full-vector error<=5% on every resolved held-out case and each question's median<=quadratic median+0.005. Unresolved/zero-delivery cases are reported, not contraction or successes. An accurate angle with a wrong vector fails.
metrics: Per case: full-vector absolute/relative error, predicted/measured magnitude and gain, magnitude error, vector direction error, +/- response angle, odd/even norms, nominal versus actual-input prediction, representability floors. Summaries at independent-question level plus every case; no token-level population p-values.
decomposition: On calibration data only, verify exact FP64 SwiGLU quadratic-even component and rational identity at the8 declared control points. At all16 calibration question/position/direction base pairs and6 signed strong inputs (96 diagnostic points), retain a fixed2x2 factorial: linearized versus exact normalization, first- versus second-order gate expansion, with exact linear up projection. Save the vector interaction (exact_norm_gate2-exact_norm_gate1)-(linear_norm_gate2-linear_norm_gate1). These diagnostics do not enter candidate selection or become extra held-out candidates. No generator change or causal-percentage claim from nonorthogonal components.

output_extension.admission: Only after decisive MLP comparison is incrementally preserved and numerical gates pass. Require>=1500 native seconds remaining under original2400 native stop and>=3GiB free memory; otherwise mark unexecuted with reason, without broadening the study.
output_extension.cases: Prefill: first2 calibration questions x directions0/1, all4 held-out questions x directions2/3 (12 cases). Cached decode: first2 calibration questions x direction0, all4 held-out questions x direction2 (6 cases).18 total,6 calibration and12 held-out; correctly cloned full native prefix state for cached cases.
output_extension.baseline: Actual q=J_logits*v for complete MLP local response: alpha^2/2*Var_p(q), full vocabulary. Also retain exact-softmax endpoint using alpha*q, to distinguish softmax effects from internal-response improvement.
output_extension.extensions: Propagate ordinary-quadratic, canonical-rational and calibration-selected normalized FULL residual shifts through actual baseline downstream derivative. Apply exact softmax to l_base+J_tail*predicted_delta_F. Evaluate endpoint KL(p_base||p_predicted) against KL(p_base||p_actual). If selected=rational, reuse that derivative, do not duplicate model calls. This is one local downstream approximation, not summed local KL and not an error bound on every token probability.
output_extension.actual_intervention: At block11 output add F(h+alpha*v)-F(h) at the current token, with alpha0 a null edit, on identical prefixes/held native state. Output work uses FP32 promoted weights; native BF16 endpoint generalization is not claimed.
output_extension.derivative_checks: Exact forward-mode AD preferred. At the first calibration case of each position only, one unsupported-operator reverse-JVP fallback is permitted before signed output measurements; never replace actual derivatives with FD-only scores. Null primal must match recorded FP32 hidden within1e-5 relative, with exactness separately logged. Check baseline derivative at+/-0.03125 and caller-cache immutability; fixed p-weighted centered RMS relative tolerance5%. If a position's gate fails, dependent output cases are marked unexecuted/failed with no tuning.
output_extension.support: At strength0.5, each held-out question's selected-endpoint median scalar-KL relative error must improve>=25% over both original Fisher and ordinary-quadratic endpoint, and every resolved scalar case<=25%. Strength2 is a stress test with all failures retained, not a new fitted range. Report absolute KL errors, all-vocabulary distributions and KL(actual||predicted) as a secondary check; scalar-KL agreement is not a per-token probability bound.

prior_work: RMSNorm and SwiGLU are established; Taylor/Fisher/rational approximations are not novelty claims. Limited directly relevant prior search did not establish originality. Prior resummation outcomes are development evidence. Existing references/method limitations are retained, including no mean-Jacobian product or isolated no-cache attention as evidence for cached inference.
preservation: Exact source/input/token/direction freeze before model calls; per-case predictions and outputs incremental; calibration selection locked; all negatives retained; private native/checkpoint data only. Verified local/Drive backups and owned worker exit. No old monitor restart, new chat, independent-agent review, schedule, PR merge or branch deletion.
